name: Ros Omelette
ingredients: 2 cups Chicken Xacuti gravy (or spicy coconut-based gravy)
instructions: 1. Whisk eggs with chopped onion, green chilies, coriander, and salt.
2. Heat oil in a pan and pour in the egg mixture to make a fluffy omelette; cook until golden brown on both sides.
3. Place the cooked omelette in a deep plate or bowl.
4. Ladle the hot, spicy gravy (ros) generously over the omelette until partially submerged.
5. Garnish with additional chopped onions and coriander.
6. Serve immediately with warm Goan pau to soak up the gravy.
description: Ros Omelette is a quintessential Goan street food delicacy. 'Ros' refers to gravy in Konkani. It is a humble yet soul-satisfying dish, frequently found at local night stalls, representing the fusion of Portuguese-influenced bread culture and traditional spicy Goan gravies.
